summary: Sow Good Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to a share purchase agreement and a new subscription agreement dated August 21, 2026, for its wholly owned subsidiary SOWG Tanzania Inc. to acquire 99.97% of Uranex Tanzania Limited and Magnis Technologies (Tanzania) Limited from Ryzon Materials Limited and other sellers. The transaction consideration is clarified at AUD$96,413,866, with a nominal subscription price of TZS 343,331,000 (~$129,559) for 343,331 newly issued shares. The amendment restructures the deal from a direct purchase to a share subscription, with sellers retaining 0.03% as bare nominees. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
